CORE MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 13
   C. 15
   D. 17

2. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 29
   C. 28
   D. 11

3. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 24
   C. 25
   D. 11

4. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

5. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 13
   C. 170
   D. 26

6. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 14
   C. 7
   D. 49

7. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 26

8. Solve for x: x + 4 = 10. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 4
   C. 7
   D. 10

9. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 122
   C. 121
   D. 22

10. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

11. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 20
   C. 1
   D. 21

12. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 48
   C. 156
   D. 24

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

1. B — 13
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 5² + 12²
3. c² = 25 + 144
4. c² = 169
5. c = 13
Final Answer: 13 cm
Mark reminder: method mark for Pythagoras; accuracy mark for hypotenuse
